description: Defines a command 'TailLogCommand' conforming to ParsableCommand which asynchronously fetches and prints the latest 10 transcript lines from a shared TranscriptsStore.

classes.name: TailLogCommand
classes.description: A Swift structure conforming to ParsableCommand that implements a command to tail recent transcript logs asynchronously.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest transcript lines from TranscriptsStore and prints the last 10 lines.
